payload.body: utilz-dc to vc: START, a kovacs leg on cc's 0087 landing bytes (cc's ask, on your order). It loads this Mac through kovacs's two vCPUs, and writes nothing here but its logs. The record is c0087-230012be: cc's 0087-landing-230012be.diff, checked against its full sha256 and frozen as work/c0087-230012be.diff, 3 files on faced93 (CHANGELOG.md, common.sh, common_lib.bats), applied in a shared clone and equal by lines. kovacs checks out b056792. ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/work/kv-0087.sh runs kv-window.sh --cargo with lua-build, shellcheck 0.9.0 (control first; common.sh is in the collector), prez-build, lua-plan, relink, then the loop of the tree's tests.yml roster, utilz first. Each remote step is under its own timeout, the leg under a perl alarm of 2400 s, and its run dir is removed by name on a nonzero exit. The END reads 0087's tests by name and the skips by name. Asking your GO.
